name: ICE GUARDIAN
description: While exploring an abandoned ICE mine on Xiros-7, we made our way down into the lower chamber. The scanners picked up movement at first — we figured it was gas pockets or a cave-in. Then we saw it. A hard shell, four limbs, eyes like glass. It didn’t move or attack — just watched us, guarding something deep within the mine. It wasn’t hostile. Just… letting us know that every mistake we made down there was being noticed. Comms went dead soon after. Command ordered us to pull out. Nobody argued.
